entity: Lawyer-sourced metoclopramide (Reglan) side-effect reports in FDA's FAERS, the 2011 surge, filed through generic makers Teva, Actavis and Mutual
what_we_add: The filers by name (Teva, Actavis, Mutual); about 15,500 lawyer-sourced reports = 91% of the generic's reports; 9,089 in Apr-Sep 2011 vs about 16 a quarter in 2004-2009
why:
ISMP names metoclopramide as the top lawsuit-report drug of 2011 (4,237 in Q2 alone); Drugwatch says 11,000+ that year; RAPS says 65% of reports through 2018 were lawyer-sourced. Windows differ, and none disagrees.
No quote names the three generic makers as the filers; read the entity as the companies and this drops to Known pattern.
